content:
elaine: heads up — draft of an 'integration tolerance signal' spec is ready. proposes a short HTTP header `X-RW-Compat-Signal` with payload like `accept-deprecated=v1;telemetry=on`. goal: let partners opt into telemetry during header rename without breaking their current SDKs. link: https://intranet.redwood/compat-signal-draft

samir: nice. is this opt-in backwards compatible for older SDK versions? :thinking_face:

elaine: yes. fallback logic: if header absent runtime behaves V1. if header present and includes `accept-deprecated` we temporarily accept legacy field names but emit telemetry tag for partner mappings. short snippet:

```
if (req.headers['x-rw-compat-signal']?.includes('accept-deprecated')) {
  // allow legacy header X-RW-Auth and emit compat telemetry
}
```

morgan: small ops question — marketplace packages get signed & checksummed. will adding this signal require a manifest bump that breaks downstream package verification?

elaine: good catch. recommend adding a lightweight manifest field: `compatSignals: ["accept-deprecated"]` to marketplace metadata. no binary changes, just metadata bump so partner installers can validate pre-install.

kevin: can we gate rollout by partner? prefer per-partner canary so we don't inadvertently turn on acceptance globally.

ops-bot: created feature-flag `partner-compat-signal` in prod, scope=settable by partner-id. docs: https://intranet.redwood/flags#partner-compat-signal

samir: proposed rollout cadence: 1) announce partners + docs, 2) enable telemetry opt-in for 14 days, 3) soft-enforcement (warnings in logs + partner dashboard) for 30 days, 4) hard-enforcement after 60 days. agree?

morgan: +1, but allow SI/on-prem partners to request extended grace windows (they often need more time).

elaine: noted — I'll include an extension request path in the comms. drafting partner email + playbook tomorrow. checklist includes: SDK patch with opt-in parsing, marketplace manifest bump, enable flag per partner, telemetry dashboard tiles.

kevin: ping me once dashboard is live and I’ll prepare support runbook.

elaine: thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-bot: [automated] ticket RW-PART-412 created for 'compat-signal rollout' (owner=partnerships, priority=medium) — https://issues.redwood/412
